cadence.note: One session per block, around the clock: 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, 18:00 America/Chicago.

lifecycle.no_orphans: Scheduled runs must stop after graduation: the worker exits quietly when all 120 sessions are complete. Remedials extend the program past 120 wall-clock blocks by design (mastery over calendar speed); the no-op condition is program completion, not a date.
lifecycle.owner: UNSET — establish a lifecycle owner before creating a durable cron; until then this file is the spec, not a live schedule.

runner.behavior: Runs the next uncompleted session in the 1..120 sequence (catch-up, never skip). If a remedial is pending, it runs the remedial BEFORE any new syllabus session. After graduation (all 120 complete) the command is a quiet no-op.
